stories.title: Flavio Bolsonaro refuses to recognize Lula's re-election win in Brazil
stories.summary: Senator Flavio Bolsonaro is refusing to concede to President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva after Lula's historic fourth-term election victory, echoing his imprisoned father's 2022 stance and raising fears of renewed political turmoil.

stories.title: Venezuela's Maria Corina Machado returns from exile
stories.summary: Opposition leader Maria Corina Machado has returned to Venezuela after nearly a year in exile to press for new elections, a high-risk move against the government that has sidelined her.

stories.title: US has plans for major Iran strikes if Trump orders, officials say
stories.summary: US forces in the Middle East are positioned to launch major new strikes against Iran within 96 hours of a Trump order, officials said, as Washington keeps military options open.

stories.title: Houthis say they attacked Saudi oil pumping stations and Riyadh airport
stories.summary: Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis said they attacked Saudi Arabia's East-West oil pumping stations and Riyadh airport, as rising hostilities choke oil supplies and threaten a wider conflict.

stories.title: Ex-DOGE founders' AI startup says it broke into Anthropic in 12 hours
stories.summary: Cathedral, a cybersecurity startup founded by ex-DOGE staffers, says it accessed Anthropic's internal systems, including Slack messages and employee data, in 12 hours under an Anthropic security-testing program.

stories.title: Reddit's r/opensource bans AI-made and AI-focused projects
stories.summary: Reddit's r/opensource community banned AI-built and AI-focused projects, plus non-English speakers, in sweeping new rules that sparked backlash over Linux kernel contributions and solo developers.

stories.title: Chinese video AI models beat US rivals on visual quality, study finds
stories.summary: Chinese AI video-generation models now outperform leading US rivals on visual quality but lag on safety safeguards, according to a University of Hong Kong study that ranked ByteDance's Seedance top overall.

stories.title: SpaceX closes $40 billion debt deal for AI chips, Musk says
stories.summary: Elon Musk said SpaceX closed $40 billion in debt financing to buy GPUs expected in the first half of 2027, while warning that most AI rivals are now cut off from AI debt markets.

stories.title: Andre Szmyt kicks third game-winner as Browns move to 5-2
stories.summary: Kicker Andre Szmyt drilled his third game-winning field goal of the season, a 32-yarder as time expired, lifting the Browns past the Titans 27-24 and keeping Cleveland atop the AFC North.

stories.title: Maliek Collins: 'I love the city of Cleveland' after extension
stories.summary: Defensive tackle Maliek Collins said he hopes Cleveland is his last NFL stop after agreeing to a two-year, $30 million extension, a reward for his 3.5-sack rebound season.

stories.title: KC Concepcion's breakout: 8 catches, 129 yards vs. Titans
stories.summary: Rookie receiver KC Concepcion turned in his best game as a pro with eight catches for 129 yards, all in the first half of the Browns' 27-24 comeback win over Tennessee.

stories.title: Deshaun Watson leads Browns past Titans 27-24 in walk-off win
stories.summary: Deshaun Watson engineered his fifth game-winning fourth-quarter drive of the season, setting up a walk-off field goal as Cleveland beat Tennessee 27-24 to improve to 5-2.

stories.title: Meet Luke Fahey, the freshman now holding Ohio State's season
stories.summary: With Julian Sayin out with a shoulder injury, true freshman Luke Fahey is set to start at quarterback for Ohio State beginning at USC on Oct. 31, after beating out Tavien St. Clair for the job.

stories.title: Urban Meyer questions Ohio State's quarterback situation
stories.summary: Urban Meyer expressed skepticism about Ohio State's quarterback room after Julian Sayin's injury, arguing the Buckeyes 'went backwards' and spotlighting the depth question behind freshman Luke Fahey.

stories.title: Ohio State women's soccer clinches Big Ten regular-season title
stories.summary: Ohio State women's soccer shut out Illinois 3-0 to claim the outright 2026 Big Ten regular-season championship, setting a program record for league wins in a season.

stories.title: Bynum scores 23 as Ohio State beats Butler in exhibition
stories.summary: Amare Bynum scored 23 points to lead Ohio State past Butler 82-73 in its final men's basketball exhibition before next Monday's season opener.

stories.title: The single lap that cost Leclerc a shot at victory in Austin
stories.summary: Formula 1 breaks down the one lap that cost Charles Leclerc a shot at victory in the United States Grand Prix, where he finished second behind Kimi Antonelli.

stories.title: Verstappen pinpoints two recurring Red Bull problems
stories.summary: Max Verstappen identified two recurring Red Bull problems after a frustrating United States Grand Prix, joking the team 'should use sign language' over its radio struggles.

stories.title: Alonso blasts driving standards of bottom half of F1 grid
stories.summary: Fernando Alonso criticized the driving standards of the bottom half of the F1 grid, saying driver quality is 'very low' toward the back of the field.

stories.title: Wolff hails Antonelli's 'best race' in Austin
stories.summary: Toto Wolff called Kimi Antonelli's Austin victory his 'best race' so far, with the Mercedes driver now two points from clinching the 2026 world championship.

stories.title: Audit: Ex-charter school manager cost Columbus school nearly $500K
stories.summary: A state audit found a former Columbus charter school business manager convicted of theft is responsible for nearly $500,000 in losses at Westside Academy.

stories.title: Columbus firefighters battle heavy residential fire on Wilson Drive
stories.summary: Columbus firefighters responded to a heavy residential fire on Wilson Drive after smoke was seen coming from the roof of a home.

stories.title: Ohio Haitians and supporters march on Columbus with demands
stories.summary: Haitian community members and supporters marched from Springfield to Columbus to demand immigration protections and an end to detentions.

stories.title: Two shot overnight in Franklinton, Columbus police investigate
stories.summary: Two people were wounded in an overnight shooting in Franklinton near Central High School, and Columbus police are investigating.
